C0396.title: Guizhou Huaxi District Court Convicts Defendants for Illegally "Farming" Accounts to Profit from Personal Information
C0396.summary: Defendants Chen and Tang illegally purchased and obtained citizens' mobile phone numbers and verification codes to register and bind Douyin accounts. They also used automated liking software to artificially "farm" the accounts, then sold them to intermediaries for profit after gaining followers. The court ruled the act constituted the crime of infringing on citizens' personal information.

references.title: Huaxi District People's Court, Guiyang City | Illegal 'Account Farming' for Profit Leads to Conviction for Infringing Personal Information
